messages:
linh: quick ask: can someone share nsys + torchprof from the perf run that showed increased decode p50 on rtx-40? I need traces to generate flamegraphs. commit f3b2a1fa, test run at ~2026-03-15 21:40 UTC. cc @priyanka @alex :eyes:

priyanka: I captured nsys and torch profiler, uploading now. it's ~1.2GB zipped. included nvtx ranges for 'decode' stage. will post link when done.

ops-bot: Upload complete: s3://redwood-inference/perf-captures/2026-03-15/f3b2a1fa_nsys.tgz (access: team-eng-runtime).

alex: Thanks. quick Q: which model & seq len? branch `perf/regress-2026` had quant change, could be related.

priyanka: Model: zoo/gpt2-medium-qlora, seq=2048, batch=8. run command: `python bench_decode.py --model ... --seq 2048 --batch 8 --profile`

linh: Perfect. priyanka can you include the nsys report command you used? and if you have the torchprof trace (.pt) that'd be great.

priyanka: yes: nsys profile --output f3b2_profile --trace=cuda --sample=cpu,cupti python bench_decode.py ...
Also ran `python scripts/torchprof_to_chrome.py traces/torchprof.pt -o traces/torchprof.json`

maria: If you're generating flamegraphs, use `nsys convert --format=flamegraph f3b2_profile.qdrep -o f3b2_fgs.html` or `nsys stats --format=csv` then perf scripts. I can try a quick flamegraph and post screenshot.

perf-bot: Perf run detected: decode p50 increased +22% vs baseline (2026-03-10). Tagging #perf-regressions.

alex: I grabbed the upload, but can't access s3 path from my laptop – gets AccessDenied. priyanka can you `aws s3 cp` to the shared team bucket or add acl?

priyanka: done. public link (internal): https://files.redwood/team-eng-runtime/f3b2_trace_bundle_20260315.tgz :thumbsup:

linh: :thumbsup: I'll pull and run `nsys-ui` + `flamegraph.pl` chain. Quick note: prefer smaller window around decode (use `nsys stats --start 60 --duration 30`), avoids huge capture.

alex: If you post the output flamegraph HTML I can eyeball hotspots. tagging @maria for kernel-level hints.

maria: Working on it. ran `python tools/flamegen.py traces/torchprof.json -o /tmp/f3b2_fg.html` — looks like most time in `attention_forward` and libcudnn conv. sample lines: `attention_forward: 42.1%`, `cudnn_convolution: 28.7%`

priyanka: Also added NVTX ranges `decode_start`/`decode_end` — filter in UI.

linh: Great. Next steps: I'll make a quick canary with `--disable-quant` to check. If regression reproduces without quant change, we'll open a perf bug.

alex: I'll queue a canary on dedicated infra with the same commit and run bench.sh for 3x repeats.

priyanka: FYI I saved the converted chrome trace here: https://files.redwood/team-eng-runtime/f3b2_chrome_trace.json

linh: awesome. thanks everyone. I'll post findings in thread by EOD. :coffee:
